name: LSM-3520
summary: CGS-20625 is an anxiolytic drug used in scientific research. It has similar effects to benzodiazepine drugs, but is structurally distinct and so is classed as a nonbenzodiazepine anxiolytic. It produces anxiolytic and anticonvulsant effects, but with no sedative effects even at high doses, and no significant muscle relaxant effects. It is orally active in humans, but with relatively low bioavailability.

pharmacology.text: CGS-20625 is a positive allosteric modulator at several GABAA receptors types. Due to its alicyclic moiety potency at γ1 subunit, containing receptor types is more pronounced for CGS-20625 compared to benzodiazepines.

uses.text: CGS-20625 is an anxiolytic drug used in scientific research.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about its effects in people. Drugs that boost GABA-A receptors in a similar way, such as the benzodiazepines, can cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory problems and dependence, although this compound was reported to cause little sedation.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。以類似方式增強 GABA-A 受體的藥物，例如苯二氮平類，可能引起嗜睡、協調變差、記憶問題與依賴，不過據報這個化合物的鎮靜作用很弱。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。以类似方式增强 GABA-A 受体的药物，例如苯二氮平类，可能引起嗜睡、协调制差、记忆问题与依赖，不过据报这个化合物的镇静作用很弱。

fact.en: The CGS prefix in its code name CGS-20625 comes from the Swiss drug company Ciba-Geigy, which developed it. It acts at the same GABA-A receptors as benzodiazepines but has a quite different chemical structure.
fact.zh: 它的代號 CGS-20625 中的「CGS」來自研發它的瑞士藥廠汽巴嘉基。它作用於與苯二氮平類相同的 GABA-A 受體，化學結構卻截然不同。
fact.zhHans: 它的代号 CGS-20625 中的「CGS」来自研发它的瑞士药厂汽巴嘉基。它作用于与苯二氮平类相同的 GABA-A 受体，化学结构却截然不同。
